content: Cancel for inline add forms on mobile: tap-outside can be unintentional and confusing (users may not know what happened). Explicit text-labeled cancel button is clearer than an X icon. Apps like Yelp and Etsy use explicit Cancel/Apply labels. For an inline web form, an explicit cancel link/button that removes the injected form element is preferred over relying on tap-outside-only; empty-title auto-dismiss on submit is a valid lightweight alternative for experienced users.
